_about: Bring-item icon notes per monster. pit/shock/flash/sonic: true = works, false = no effect (missing = unknown). sec: seconds [normal, enraged, exhausted] per item. status: what the monster inflicts (its attack element as 火属性やられ etc., and ailments); from a monster weakness table merged with hand-written entries. frog: can be pulled out of the water with 釣りカエル (hand-written). Trap/flash/sonic data for all 94 large monsters were matched to monsters.json by hitzone tables.
